examples.verbatim_snippet: Whereas it appears to the Lt. Governor, Delhi that land is likely to be needed to be taken by Government at the public expense for a public purpose, namely for Planned Development of Delhi. Notification No. F.15(111)/62-Land & Building dated 23-01-1965 u/s 4 of L.A. Act was issued.
Declaration under Section 6 of the Land Acquisition Act was issued vide Notification No. F.15(111)/62-L&B dated 07-12-1966 for Village Galibpur.
The Collector fixed the market value of Block A land at Rs. 27,000/- per bigha and Block B land at Rs. 22,000/- per bigha along with 30% Solatium u/s 23(2).
Khasra No. 12//4 min (2-04), 12//5 (4-16), 13//1 (4-12) total area 11 Bigha 12 Biswa in Village Bijwasan.
Physical possession of the land measuring 142 Bigha 08 Biswa was taken over on 15-09-1998 and handed over to DDA on the same day.
